versions.changelog:
Tyche 1.0.4 — Minor update

- Corrected all text encoding errors and replaced garbled characters with proper Unicode, improving user experience.
- Updated the skill description and emoji to display symbols correctly (e.g., “—”, “⚖️💸”).
- Added a section outlining the Tyche Pro upgrade, with instructions and pricing.
- No code changes were made to the underlying logic or functionality.
Improvement: better CSV error handling, late fee calculations, 3-tier reminder templates

Tyche v1.0.0 — Initial Release

- Generate professional invoice files for each client from a simple CSV.
- Track invoice payment status and calculate overdue days.
- Automatically add tax and late fee (configurable via environment variables).
- Send automated payment reminder templates (friendly, firm, final).
- Provides a real-time dashboard: paid vs outstanding vs overdue amounts.
- Runs fully local—no data transmitted for privacy and security.
